evidence_slice: London Borough of Islington adopted its new Local Plan on 28 September 2023. The adopted Site Allocations document identifies NH10, 45 Hornsey Road and 252 Holloway Road, including 45 Hornsey Road (land and railway arches 1–21 to rear), N7 7DD and 252 Holloway Road, N7 6NE. The site is approximately 5,167 square metres, in Ashburton Trading Limited and Network Rail ownership, with storage and distribution floorspace (B8) as the current/previous use. The allocation supports redevelopment for conventional housing; 45 Hornsey Road may also be suitable for student accommodation, while commercial uses, particularly light industrial uses, should be maintained under the railway arches. The Greater London Authority Planning Local Plan Data service publishes Islington local-plan policy-map GIS under Open Government Licence v3.0, with Site Allocations as layer 41 in EPSG:27700.
